# Groves Real Estate Painting

> Painting company in Erie, Pennsylvania. Interior and exterior painting for homes, rentals and commercial properties, plus property cleanouts and hauling. Free quotes.

## Business facts

- Name: Groves Real Estate Painting
- Location: Erie, PA, USA
- Service area: Erie, PA and the surrounding area
- Phone: (814) 873-2129 (Jarrod), (814) 881-2723 (Jordan)

## Services

- Residential painting: interior and exterior painting for houses and rentals, including walls, trim, cabinets, siding, porches and decks.
- Commercial painting: offices, retail spaces and industrial buildings.
- Cleanouts and hauling: full property cleanouts with haul-away, no dumpster needed.

Quotes are free. Call (814) 873-2129 or use the quote form at https://grovesrealestatepainting.com/#contact
